capabilities: Guide a four-step Feynman workflow (select, explain, find gaps, simplify) with AI follow-up questioning
Score explanations and reviews on three dimensions and verify gap coverage
Schedule spaced repetition reviews with dynamic intervals and weak-point drills
Extract concepts from pasted articles into a learning queue
Push completed learning sessions to a Notion database
extras: Recommended install path is BRAT because the plugin is beta; default model is deepseek-chat and parts of the UI text are in Chinese; the README states the API key is stored locally and no telemetry is sent.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in guided workflow for learning concepts by explaining them, identifying gaps, and reviewing them on a spaced schedule.

relations.evidence: Notion sync — Push each completed learning session to a Notion database

summary: AI-guided Feynman technique learning tool with a four-step explain-and-find-gaps workflow, spaced repetition review, and Notion sync.
